test_to_time_parser: test the to_time function converts a time string like '14:15' to a datetime.time object
test_to_time_custom_format: test the to_time function with a custom format string like '%H.%M' to parse non-standard time strings
test_to_time_array_input: test the to_time function converts a list of time strings to a list of datetime.time objects
test_to_time_series_input: test the to_time function converts a pandas Series of time strings to a Series of datetime.time objects
test_to_time_errors_coerce: test the to_time function with errors='coerce' returns None for unparseable time strings
